approvalRule: Holdout MAE must improve by at least 0.03 points; otherwise matchup layer remains diagnostic only.
productionTreatment: Display unit matchup advantages in Matchup Center, but apply 0.0 matchup points to final fair spread until a richer current-personnel/pressure/coverage model passes holdout validation.
notes: Target is residual after 70% prior team-strength carryover + 1.0 HFA.
Unit inputs are prior-season play-by-play only.
Simple unit interactions failed the 2024-2025 holdout and therefore are not betting inputs.
Next version will add QB-under-pressure performance, current personnel state, OL continuity, pass-rush personnel and coverage personnel.
